## Import from your database
**File → Import from database.** Pick your dialect, copy the read-only query drawDB gives you, run it in the SQL client you already use (psql, Workbench, DBeaver, SSMS…), and paste the result back. drawDB draws the diagram and auto-arranges it.
- Works with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite and Oracle

* Snapshot reports use the latest submitted **DuckDB Sync** with all tables copied and show its date as the snapshot time. They open the sync in read-only mode, avoiding file-lock conflicts when reports run at the same time. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/45817)
* Updates generated CI workflows to install the available MariaDB client package and configure it to connect without TLS to the MariaDB 10.6 test server. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44619)
* Preserves TLS when the client cache connects to Redis through a `rediss://` address, rather than switching to an unencrypted connection. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/45088)

## Bug Fixes
* Applies the configured release rules for breaking changes, preventing version-16 releases from being incorrectly assigned a major-version number. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44914)
* Checks access permissions when the _File URL_ on a **File** changes, preventing users from linking to files they cannot access. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44347)
* Fixes blank pages when opening query reports whose names contain apostrophes. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44497)
* U

* MariaDB database updates now preserve automatically generated columns and their unique indexes instead of treating them as removed fields. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44863)
* Loads large supporting libraries only when needed, reducing memory use in workers and command-line tools; administrators can also choose which database drivers load in advance with `FRAPPE_PRELOAD_DATABASE_DRIVERS`. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44696)
* Reduces database queries during Desk startup by checking nu

* Reconnects to the database before **Google Drive** backups save _Last Backup On_, so long uploads can still record their completion and send the success email. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44589)

* Updates “is set” and “is not set” filters to treat zero as empty for numeric fields and check dates and times using supported empty values, preventing PostgreSQL errors on these fields. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/43863)

## Bug Fixes
* Adds a Pulse telemetry settings endpoint for Frappe UI apps on version 15, preventing their settings requests from failing when they load. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/44450)

**Reviewers**: @RitvikSardana, @iamejaaz

### 误删保护

- 删除任务后提供十秒快捷撤销；管理窗口新增“最近删除”，七天内可恢复，过期后自动清理。
- 删除期间保留原始任务字段与提醒配置，但退出待办统计、编辑和提醒队列；关闭相关未确认弹窗。
- 恢复保留未来提醒和历史去重记录，不补发已过去的通知。删除、恢复与整轮调度互斥，后台等待不阻塞窗口线程。
- 数据库升级至 v6，迁移前在线备份；支持恢复 v4 / v

### 导航与提醒操作

- 悬浮窗与托盘中的“设置”直接进入管理窗口的设置页；导航请求缓存到前端接收并确认，避免首次打开窗口时漏掉跳转。
- 提醒卡片新增单条“完成任务”“稍后 5 / 10 分钟”“查看详情”，保留批量稍后和确认操作。
- 查看详情打开对应任务编辑页，成功请求打开后仅确认该条提醒；不会把任务标记为完成，窗口正在编辑其他内容时保留草稿，待编辑关闭后
- Native QA instance: language selected through Settings, persisted to SQLite, and restored in English after restart.
